reason: A read-only settings interface for browsing, searching, inspecting, and copying registered agent skills and their documentation.

summaries.zh: 在设置页中浏览、搜索和查看已注册的 agent skill，并可复制技能正文或本地路径。
summaries.en: A read-only settings interface for browsing, searching, inspecting, and copying registered agent skills and their local paths.

capabilities: Reads the host skill registry and merges skill listings across agent preset scopes
Displays skill metadata, file paths, resource directories, and SKILL.md content
Provides search and filtering over available skills
Polls for refreshed skill data and exposes local plugin endpoints for the web client
Copies skill content or local paths to the clipboard
